title: Descent of algebras along a flat ring map (Stacks 023N, algebra form)
statement:
Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $A$ is a flat $R$-module [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], and let $B$ be a commutative $A$-algebra, an $R$-algebra through $R\to A\to B$. Regard the tensor product $A\otimes_RB$ [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property] as an $A$-algebra through its left factor, $a\mapsto a\otimes1$; let $\mu:A\otimes_RB\to B$ be the $A$-algebra map $a\otimes b\mapsto ab$ and $\iota:B\to A\otimes_RB$ the $R$-algebra map $b\mapsto1\otimes b$. Let $\delta:B\to A\otimes_RB$ be a homomorphism of $A$-algebras such that
(i) (counit) $\mu(\delta(b))=b$ for all $b\in B$, and
(ii) (coassociativity) $(\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\delta)(\delta(b))=(\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\iota)(\delta(b))$ in $A\otimes_R(A\otimes_RB)$ for all $b\in B$, where $\mathrm{id}_A\otimes\delta,\ \mathrm{id}_A\otimes\iota:A\otimes_RB\to A\otimes_R(A\otimes_RB)$ are the $R$-algebra maps $a\otimes b\mapsto a\otimes\delta(b)$ and $a\otimes b\mapsto a\otimes1\otimes b$.
Let $C=\{b\in B:\delta(b)=1\otimes b\}$. Then $C$ is an $R$-subalgebra of $B$, and the map $\kappa:A\otimes_RC\to B$, $a\otimes c\mapsto ac$, is an isomorphism of $A$-algebras.
